verdict.rationale: Filee lists "metadata" as a per-file-type preset option, and those presets can be applied from the CLI with --preset. That points to some first-party metadata control during conversion. The docs never say whether this preset preserves metadata, strips it, or both, or which formats it covers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of metadata preservation through conversions, an explicit strip-on-request option, the metadata types and formats covered (EXIF, document properties, audio tags), and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, file metadata is preserved through a conversion or strippable on request

citations.quote: Presets per file type: quality, resizing, rotate and flip, DPI, grayscale, metadata, background removal, Trace to SVG
"filee convert <files, wildcards or folders> --to <format>" (or "--preset <preset>") converts with the app's engines and presets
